data.name: Willetta
data.gender_notes: Willetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old German name Wilhelmina, meaning 'resolute protector'. This name was borne by St. Wilgefortis, a legendary martyr who was said to have been miraculously saved from her pagan father's plans to marry her off to an idol. She was later tortured and killed for her faith, becoming a patron saint of the impossible and difficult situations.
data.etymology: Willetta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Willful helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Willetta total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
